Complete the requested task in the shared workspace. Follow repository guidance, make focused changes, and run the relevant checks.
Runtime-owned workspace setup guidance:

Leave ignored dependencies there. Put standalone tools under an executable user path: use `$ZEROSHOT_TOOLS/bin` when provided (shared by all nodes), otherwise `$HOME/.local/bin`. Do not install tools in `/tmp` (possibly `noexec`).

{"task":"Add a function `slugify(text: str) -> str` to textkit/core.py that lowercases the text, replaces every run of non-alphanumeric characters with a single '-', and strips leading and trailing '-'. Export it from textkit/__init__.py and add unit tests to tests/test_core.py. Run `python3 -m unittest -v` and make sure it passes."}

{"kind":"worker","output":{"kind":"null"}}

The provider response must be exactly an object with one field named response.
